name: Detective INNA DUKE
source: Detective Inna Duke is a noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?
translation: 《侦探Inna Duke》是一部黑色故事驱动的视觉小说，你将与Inna Duke中尉和她的搭档Fernal下士合作，调查流行主播Oleh Hamston的神秘绑架事件。但你能在多雨的城市找到这只可怜的仓鼠吗？
